title: freeze RC18 isolated installed-system drill authority contract

criteria: Contract freezes the gate order from RC17 exact evidence into disposable image boundary, baseline, fail-closed fixtures, isolated install, isolated update, rollback preconditions, rollback, support/recovery, consumer smoke, and final audit.
Contract states the installed-system image or VM is the only writable drill surface.

Contract forbids host rootfs mutation, host active slot mutation, host boot metadata mutation, support upload, recovery execution service, remote dispatch, production ring mutation, mirror/frontend authority, signer authority, and GA claims.
